description:
"My fake husband has a lover, and that lover is jealous of me. And a mad dog has just appeared, insisting on inserting himself into this fucked-up family tree." A three-year sham marriage initiated to cover up the scandals of a presidential candidate backed by conservatives. Left alone in New York, Korean-American Lee Yu-ri served as her husband Aaron's perfect shield and sanctuary. She had planned to step down cleanly and return to a peaceful routine once the election was over, but the moment she stepped into the VVIP room of Aces Department Store, everything fell apart. Leoluca Casani: an Italian mafia boss reeking of blood and dangerous lust. With his rough touch ruthlessly shattering the boundaries of her perfect disguise, Yu-ri's sturdy world begins to melt away in a sticky collapse. "The marriage vows you're keeping all by yourself are void. So, get into my bed."
